landing.hero_title: Every sum in your driving school, under control
landing.hero_sub: Debtor list, daily revenue, branch report — right in your phone.
landing.benefits_sub: Everything you need to run a driving school
landing.benefit1_body: Who owes what — at a glance. Debtors by branch, remaining balance, and payment date.
landing.benefit2_body: Teachers mark attendance in 2 taps. Per-group attendance, late arrivals, and excused absences.
landing.benefit3_body: Groups and lessons, automated. Weekly schedule templates, lesson generation, and reports.
landing.faq1_a: A CRM for your driving school — manage students, groups, attendance and payments from one panel. No install: works in browser and phone.
landing.faq2_q: How many branches can I connect?
landing.faq2_a: Unlimited. Each branch has separate reports, attendance and payment data.
landing.faq3_a: Yes. Data is stored on encrypted servers, accessible only by you and your staff.
landing.faq4_a: Contact us via Telegram for pricing. The trial period is free.
landing.faq5_q: Can I enroll students without a group?
landing.faq5_a: Yes. Avtomaktab CRM handles groupless flow too — enroll a student directly and manage attendance and payments without a group.
landing.cta2_title: Put your school under control — starting today
landing.cta2_sub: Start with the demo — no installation needed.
landing.features_sub: Every feature built from a real need
landing.feature_debt_body: Debtor list, remaining balance, overdue days — at a glance. Full report by branch, overdue debts highlighted separately.
landing.feature_att_body: Open the group list, tap a student — Present / Absent / Late. The attendance log saves automatically, no retry needed.
landing.feature_sch_title: Set the schedule once, it runs itself
landing.feature_sch_body: Based on schedule templates, lessons for future weeks are created automatically. Groups, teachers and lesson types — all in one place.
landing.howit_sub: Four simple steps — up and running from day one
landing.howit_step1_body: Contact us via Telegram or phone — we reply within 15 minutes
landing.howit_step2_body: Company, branch, and staff accounts — ready in 1 day
landing.howit_step4_body: We stay close for the first days and answer every question
landing.roles_sub: Find your position — a dedicated view for each
landing.role_owner_body: All-branch reports, revenue and debt control in one panel.
landing.role_manager_body: Branch management: groups, staff and daily reports.
landing.role_operator_body: Fast student and payment entry. "Save and add another" button included.
landing.role_teacher_body: Your groups and attendance — marked in 2 taps.
landing.faq6_q: Does it work on a phone?
landing.faq6_a: Yes, fully in the browser — iPhone, Android, tablet. Nothing to install.
landing.faq7_q: Is the first month really free?
landing.faq7_a: Yes, the first month is completely free. After that, a plan sized to your school — contact us for details.
landing.faq8_q: Can one school see another school's data?
landing.faq8_a: No. Each school's data is fully isolated — daily backups run automatically.
landing.pain_lead: End of month: who paid, who didn't — scattered across notebooks, Excel, and Telegram. Pulling branch totals together takes a whole day.
landing.pain_card1_body: Who hasn't paid, how much is left — impossible to see at a glance
landing.pain_card2_body: Gets lost. Every teacher tracks it differently.
landing.pain_card3_title: Branch summary takes a full day
landing.pain_card3_body: Numbers are scattered — you have to pull them together every time
landing.pain_bridge: Avtomaktab CRM brings all of this into one panel.
